observed_issue: The Source Parquet HEAD response arrived with HTTP200 metadata, then Chromium emitted net::ERR_ABORTED. Subsequent bounded Parquet GETs succeeded. The exact cancellation cause is unknown.

primary_semantics.interpretation: HEAD responses carry representation metadata and have no response content. They do not provide any dataset byte-read proof.

narrow_head_rule: Validate actual successful HEAD status, exact planned Content-Length, media type and usable origin CORS before recording verified metadata.
Preserve a later ERR_ABORTED as an explicit cancellation observation when those exact metadata checks already passed. Do not relabel it as a completed body transfer or ranged GET.
Missing/wrong metadata, non-success status, cancellation before verified headers, and all failed GET requests remain failures.
render_completion: Wait for in-flight Source requests and response verification to settle within a bounded timeout before each screenshot.
Require actual tile-data access, not just a PMTiles header response, before treating its style as exercised.
Inspect the saved images manually; a canvas and successful data requests alone do not establish visible dataset rendering.
unchanged: Same frozen staged catalog plan and immutable Source plan.
Same selected datasets/styles and range, byte-budget, CORS and integrity requirements.
The three-collection run remains partial and cannot satisfy the final five-collection gate or deployed-Pages gate.
